question: Major Dhyan Chand is a famous name in the game of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Major Dhyan Chand is widely regarded as one of the greatest field hockey players of all time.
 
• He was part of the Indian hockey team that won three Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• His extraordinary goal-scoring ability earned him the nickname "The Wizard" or "The Magician" of hockey.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand's birthday, August 29, is celebrated as National Sports Day in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Field Hockey**

 
 
• Field hockey is a team sport played on grass or artificial turf, where teams use curved sticks to hit a small, hard ball into the opposing team's goal.
 
• It is an Olympic sport, with men’s field hockey being included since 1908 and women’s field hockey since 1980.
 
• The game is known for its fast pace, requiring skillful dribbling, passing, and strategic play.
 
• Field hockey is popular in many countries, particularly in Europe, Asia, Australia, and Africa.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Games**
 
 
• The Olympic Games are a major international multi-sport event divided into summer and winter editions, with athletes from around the world competing.
 
• Field hockey has been a part of the Summer Olympics program since 1908 for men and since 1980 for women.
 
• Winning an Olympic medal is considered one of the highest achievements in the sport.
 
• India is historically one of the most successful nations in Olympic field hockey, especially during the early to mid-20th century.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Day**
 
 
• India celebrates National Sports Day on August 29 every year to honor the legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• On this day, various sports events and activities are organized across the country to promote sports and physical fitness.
 
• The President of India gives out sports-related awards like the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, Arjuna Award, Dronacharya Award, and Dhyan Chand Award on this occasion.
 
• It serves as a reminder of the importance of sports in maintaining health, discipline, and teamwork.
